issue.title: Port the AI waiting experience to native
issue.body:
**What:** RN shows text status and a "Check waiting picture" button. Port the Waiting Polaroid, progress dial, confetti and minimize-and-return.

**Where:** Svelte `AiWaitingPolaroid.svelte`, `AiDial.svelte`, `AiConfetti.svelte`, `AiResultStage.svelte`; RN `rsdDrawing/RsdAiSheet.tsx`.

**Done when:** a generation shows the Polaroid and dial while waiting and celebrates the result.

Part of #2690.
issue.display_title: Port the AI waiting experience to native

comments.body: Done in #2774 (merged into `codex/native-migration`): Waiting Polaroid with the drawing, progress dial and confetti, arrival reveal, minimize-and-return through a corner print, reduce-motion handling.
